system.description: This passive ability grants you finer control over your animations. Hotkeys for these commands can be created using the pet window. Rank 1 - Guard - /pet guard and Follow - /pet follow. Rank 2 - Attack - /pet attack and Queue Attack - /pet qattack. Rank 3 - Back off - /pet back off, Toggle Taunt - /pet taunt (on/off), Toggle Sit - /pet sit (on/off), Toggle Stop - /pet stop (on/off), Who Leader - /pet who leader, Report Health - /pet (report) health, and Target Pet /pet target. Rank 4 - Hold and Greater Hold - /pet hold -or- /pet ghold. When your pet is in the hold state, your pet will only attack something when you tell it to, and your pet will continue to attack anything on its hate list after that point. Once the encounter is finished, your pet will automatically go back to a held state. If your pet is never told to exclusively attack anything, your pet will never attack anything, even if something is attacking it. The greater hold state forces your pet not to add anything to its hatelist unless specifically added by you. You can add a target to your pet's hatelist with either /pet attack or /pet qattack. Rank 5 - Focus - /pet focus. While focused, your pet will ignore all other opponents until the target that it was last instructed to attack is defeated. Rank 6 - Swarm and Qswarm - /pet swarm and /pet qswarm. Commands your temporary pets to attack your current target.
